description: Returns the schedule published on aprs.world for the Turkish APRS on-the-air net ("APRS Çevrimi"): whether it is active, title, day of week, local time and time zone, frequency, coordinator callsign, description, next session time (UTC) and the last session summary. The text fields are entered by the net coordinator.
name: get_turkish_aprs_net
title: Get Turkish APRS net schedule
